caption:
Letting the soup simmer

Letting the soup take its time.

Slow, gentle heat softens the tough bits and gives flavors time to blend, which a hard boil cannot do.

For whoever turns the flame up to hurry the soup.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a pot on the right giving off steam. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left. A bubble says ready? with wide eyes. Then not yet with a tilt. Then smells good. Then five more with narrowed eyes. Then now! and its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me letting the soup take its time. The last card: Choose friction.
